title: #424 Physical Books
prompt: Do you agree that physical books will eventually become obsolete?

promptSegments.text: Do you agree that physical books will eventually become obsolete?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Physical books provide a better reading experience because of the physical feeling and feel of the object.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Physical books provide a better reading experience because of the physical feeling and feel of the object.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Physical books are better for the environment because paper is easier to recycle than electronic devices.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Physical books are better for the environment because paper is easier to recycle than electronic devices.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Physical books provide a better reading experience and improve concentration.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Physical books provide a better reading experience and improve concentration.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Physical books are better for the environment compared to digital formats.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Physical books are better for the environment compared to digital formats.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Physical books are becoming less popular because digital formats offer many advantages.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Physical books are becoming less popular because digital formats offer many advantages.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another reason is the ease of access that digital books provide.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another reason is the ease of access that digital books provide.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Physical books provide a unique reading experience, offering a tactile connection that aids focus, which digital devices cannot replicate.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Physical books provide a unique reading experience, offering a tactile connection that aids focus, which digital devices cannot replicate.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Physical books sustain cultural connections and support local communities through the existence of bookstores and libraries.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Physical books sustain cultural connections and support local communities through the existence of bookstores and libraries.
